`baltimore-results.json` contains unchanged plot objects from the public March 2, 2026 Baltimore release (`https://d320iym4dtm9lj.cloudfront.net/ryan-white/C.12580.json`). It retains all 14 outcomes and both summaries for all three scenarios, with selected incidence breakdowns. Other breakdown objects are omitted to keep browser tests bounded; the aggregate file count is adjusted accordingly. Browser tests explicitly label any second-location clone as synthetic test data.

`result-data/` holds exact, content-hashed location indexes for the on-demand delivery tests, plus small unchanged plot subsets for Atlanta, AJPH Alabama, CROI Maryland and CDC testing Alabama. Baltimore plot objects come from the existing fixture above. These are actual location-specific results; the browser tests no longer substitute a Baltimore clone for state or second-city data. Fixture hashes must match the pinned result bindings. The indexes retain the full availability catalogue even where tests include only a subset of the referenced plots; an unexpected artifact request fails the test rather than accessing production.
